propositions: executor.py at 790 LOC exceeds practical headroom against the 800 LOC hard cap and must be split along a call-graph seam
step-kind I/O contract model (StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for, shallow_contract_check) forms a self-contained call-graph cluster with no edges to the run engine

the run engine cluster (run_workflow, expression resolver, RunState, StepContext, STEP_REGISTRY, dispatch) must remain in executor.py because it is a monkeypatch target and module-attribute consumer across ~50 test modules
moved symbols are re-exported from executor.py so all existing import sites remain unchanged and tests require no modification
resulting files must stay within size bounds (executor.py ≤720 LOC, step_contracts.py ≥100 LOC) with headroom and all gates (lint, typecheck, complexity baseline, tests) must pass
